pages.title: Daily Events
pages.text: Maids may encounter events involving overwork, poor nutrition, repetitive meals, nightmares, pleasant dreams, long periods without interaction, an injured master, thunderstorms, repeated attacks, and more. Some events present choices.

pages.title: Choices & Replies
pages.text: Your answer may change Trust, Fear, Favorability, Hunger, or what happens next. You can disable AI replies in the configuration if you prefer every event to use preset dialogue.
